Hence, the Company has reported NIL shareholding against TMF Business Services Limited (Formerly Tata Motors Finance Limited) within the Promoter Group. Further, pursuant to a Scheme of Arrangement Tata Motors Finance Limited (TMFL) has merged into Tata Capital Limited (TCL) with effect from May 8, 2025. Therefore, TCL has been reported under Promoter Group holding 9,120 equity shares of The Tata Power Company Limited and accordingly, 'NIL' shareholding has been reported against TMFL. 2. Tata AIA Life Insurance Company Limited holding 50,60,101 Equity Shares representing 0.16 % of the paidup Equity Share Capital are not considered part of the Promoter Group.   3. Tata Sons Private Limited (TSPL) holds 45.21 % of the Equity Shares of the Company. TSPL, being a Core Investment Company registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), is exempted from the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules 2018, as amended from time to time, on the investment made by them. Other than TSPL, no shareholder holds 10% or more of the paid-up Equity share capital of the Company. 4.
